notes:
New, each with its own switch (all off by default):

- WARP chain: your traffic goes server -> Cloudflare WARP, so sites see a Cloudflare IP. Free WARP account registered on first use. If a server can't carry it, VeePeeEn falls back to the plain server and tells you (fallback on by default).
- Clean Cloudflare IP scanner: runs only when you press Scan, shows the data estimate first, then rewrites CDN configs to the fastest clean IPs.
- Auto-failover: keeps your best tested servers as backups and switches without dropping the VPN. Checks only when the line is idle.
- Iran direct: Iranian sites and IPs bypass the VPN (rules from Chocolate4U/Iran-sing-box-rules, built in).

Fixes:
- Android: sing-box was pausing all UDP through proxy servers (affected WARP, QUIC, voice/video calls).
- WARP handshake through proxies (reserved bytes).

Docs: docs/ folder explains how everything works.
